item.title: Corris Railway release update on Tattoo steam locomotive No. 7
item.description: The Corris Railway has released a short update on its Tattoo locomotive, No. 7.

item.title: Christmas trains at Cardiff to be affected by engineering work
item.description: Major engineering work will cause disruption to train services through the Cardiff area between Christmas and the New Year.

item.title: Chief Executive named for Department for Transport Operator (DFTO)
item.description: The Chief Executive of the newly-formed Department for Transport Operator Limited (DFTO) has been named as Alex Hynes.

item.title: More Class 99 locomotives arrive into Bristol
item.description: GB Railfreight has announced that another two Class 99 locomotives have arrived in the UK. On Thursday, 27th November, 99003 and 99004 arrived at Bristol Port Company's Royal Portbury Dock. Both locomotives, which were built in Valencia, will undergo testing in the coming weeks. They will join 99001 and 99002,…

item.title: Here's how to get FREE train travel to Christmas Markets, including Cardiff, Reading and Hyde Park
item.description: Great Western Railway has launched a new challenge, with two weeks of unlimited rail travel to Christmas Markets up for grabs. The catch is that winners must wear their limited edition GWR Christmas jumper, featuring their QR code to act as their ticket. The competition is live now on GWR's…

item.title: London Euston welcomes arrival of The Polar Express with steam locomotive 44871
item.description: As announced earlier this year, the Polar Express will run from London Euston this Christmas, and it has now arrived at the station ahead of its first outing tomorrow.

item.title: Stadler appeals against Switzerland contract award
item.description: Train manufacturer Stadler is appealing against a decision by Switzerland's federal railway SBB to award a contract for 116 double-decker trains to a different company.

item.title: Denton railway line could help extend Manchester Metrolink to Stockport
item.description: A business case is being made of plans to extend the Metrolink to Stockport using the existing Denton line

item.title: LNER Train Maintenance Teams prepare for Timetable Changes
item.description: Staff at LNER Train Care Depots prepare for the ECML timetable changes

item.title: Festive disruption for Transpennine Route Upgrade works between Leeds and York
item.description: Following its announcement last month, Network Rail has confirmed that it will carry out work on the Transpennine Route Upgrade (TRU) between Leeds and York over the Christmas period and for the whole of January.
